label: event
question: List the dated events in which Steven Bajo and Stephanie Hex held or hosted an event outside Good Game, such as a fan question session, a festival talk or an awards night, in any order.
criterion: The two hosts hold, host or speak at an event that takes place outside Good Game.
why_needs_multiple: Ba mốc cùng label event; mốc e19 (label appearance, một mình) và e30 (vai trò đại sứ cuộc thi) không thuộc nhóm hoặc tiêu chí.

question: List the dated events in which a main co-host of Good Game, human or robot, was announced as a co-host or began hosting the show, in time order.
criterion: A main co-host of the show (human or robot) is announced as co-host, or begins hosting the show.
why_needs_multiple: Bốn lần có người dẫn chính mới, cần tiêu chí để loại khách mời, puppet hỗ trợ và các lần rời đi.

question: How many calendar years passed between the introduction of the yellow puppet P_Nutz in the pilot episode and the announcement of the robot co-host D.A.R.R.E.N?
criterion: Interval between two named events: the introduction of P_Nutz and the announcement of D.A.R.R.E.N.
why_needs_multiple: Hiệu số giữa hai mốc được nêu tên, không liệt kê.
